config_entries.label: Name
config_entries.description: The name of the custom effect.

config_entries.label: Update Interval
config_entries.description: The interval with which the lambda code is executed. A value of `0ms` means that the lambda is always executed, without a cool-down. Defaults to `0ms`.

config_entries.label: Lambda
config_entries.description: The code to execute. `static` variables are especially useful.
